Theme

Latin word

litterae

litterae, litterārum f. pl.

noun, first declension, plural

learning, letters: culture from reading; a letter (one or more): the plural of littera; literature, letters; a letter, a written message

In this lexicon

  • culture

    also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 11.27.6: lepōs, hūmānitās, litterae; M-O s.v. civilized: culture: literary culture

  • letter

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Trin. 3.3.65: litterās resignāre, to open a letter (Lewis & Short s.v. littera); Traupman 339

  • literature

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Tusc. 1.3: omnī litterārum genere; Cic. Leg. 1.5: abest historia litterīs nostrīs (Lewis & Short)

  • message

    also used · classical · Cic. Att. 11.24.4: nē per litterās quidem aut per nūntium
